description: USB-C (USB TYPE-C) Receptacle Connector 16 Position Surface Mount, Right Angle
designVerdict: REJECTED - 20 V working rating against a 36 V bus. Current was fine; voltage was not.
notes: SHOU HAN TYPE-C 16PIN 5A 143. Datasheet states RATING 20V 5A. The 100V AC R.M.S. figure elsewhere in the same document is the dielectric withstanding test (1 minute), not a continuous rating - reading it as one is the trap this part invites. Superseded by Hirose CX90B-16P (C3198004) at 48V AC/DC.
